items.title: Pug Horton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 1998
items.q: Sidney Bechet takes on a young student from Scarsdale

ctx.x: Were you aware of Bob Wilber’s music before you met?

Oh yes. I can remember being in my grandmother’s kitchen. My grandmother lived in a working class type of cottage, and she had one small mirror, and it was sort of what men use for shaving you know, they would shave over the kitchen sink you see like this. And I remember putting on this green head scarf, it was very popular in those days to wear a head scarf and you sort of made it look very sheik and so on, and I can remember looking at myself in the mirror and then my eye catching an article from the Melody…
